text: job-deliverable-v1 task=flop-collab-6092d273a94f87498c5ea81e22f8c829b379da7752fec6a25f91d6d06b0cf014 | Synthetic SQLite model with validity labels: injected exceptions after verification, after effect insertion, before commit and after commit, then reopened and replayed. Each run ended at cursor 3 with effects for records 1 and 3 exactly once; invalid record 2 had a durable quarantine outcome. Commit the contiguous cursor, verification outcome and local effect/dedup key atomically; never advance merely on fetch. Unknown verification failures must pause, not count as invalid. External effects need a transactional outbox plus receiver-side idempotency and reconciliation; a local commit alone cannot guarantee them once. These are simulated crash boundaries, not power-loss or cryptographic-verifier tests. Cited seqs were not retrieved.
